name: American Superconductor Corporation
business: AMSC sells megawatt-scale power resiliency systems, transformers and wind turbine electrical controls to utilities, industrial facilities, energy developers and navies.

events.what: Acquisition of Comtrafo (Brazilian distribution and power transformer maker) closed; $88.3M cash consideration; about $4.6M revenue in 19 days, roughly 30% of FY revenue annualized
events.source: doc 46478 (Q3 FY2025 call, Kosiba and McGahn); no Item 2.01 or 1.01 8-K returned by sec-api

events.what: CEO tenure: Daniel McGahn is Chairman, President and CEO on every call in the corpus back to the Baba Q3 FY2023 call (doc 85556); appointment 8-K not in sec-api coverage, so ceo_months_in_seat is null
events.source: doc 85556; sec-api 8-K 5.02 query for 2011 returned no CEO appointment

next_event.source: Baba corpus lexical search FY2027 (investor day): no hits; next scheduled item is the Q2 fiscal 2026 (Baba FY2027) earnings call, date not stated

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Management talks gross margin (about 30%, guided to improve incrementally) and opex leverage; no EBITDA or operating margin level, rate or year. Baba FY labels are keyed to fiscal year END (March): Baba FY2027 = company fiscal 2026.

street.gap_assumption: No management margin target, so no gap. Baba FY2026 is actual (company fiscal 2025, year ended 2026-03-31); FY2027 and FY2028 are consensus for company fiscal 2026 and 2027. The street already models EBITDA margin rising from 6.3% to 11.1% over two years.
street.source: Baba data_financials consensus (summary and consensus_history pid 4250 FY-2027)

evidence_of_progress.note: VA EBITDA margin yoy for Baba Q3 and Q4 FY2026 (Dec 2025 and Mar 2026 quarters). Latest reported quarter (June 2026, Baba Q1 FY2027) is not yet in VA: revenue $94.1M (+30%) but gross margin fell to 26.3% from 30%+ on Comtrafo purchase accounting, Brazil labor and mix; GAAP net income $9.5M included an $8.1M contingent consideration gain, non-GAAP net income fell to $7.6M from $11.6M. LTM margin uses Baba FY2026 (four quarters to 2026-03-31). Stage 1 industry median margin of 0.4% looks unreliable. pctile is null because only 19 months of multiple history exist; the 19-month NTM EV/EBITDA sits at the 5th percentile (data_financials summary).

verdict: Growth story, not a margin reset: long-tenured management, a mid-size Brazil deal, no numeric margin target, and estimates still falling (4-month -6.2%).
open_questions: What is Comtrafo's standalone margin and when does purchase accounting roll off?
Does the Q2 fiscal 2026 call reverse the 4-month estimate decline after the guided step-down to above $85M revenue?
Will management ever state an EBITDA or operating margin target now revenue is near $400M?
